records.copyright_owner: United States; no U.S. copyright in qualifying federal work

records.public_domain_basis: The National Transportation Library record identifies FAA as corporate creator/publisher and explicitly marks the work Public Domain; DOT policy states DOT-produced data and information are free from U.S. copyright under 17 U.S.C. 105.
records.commercial_use: ALLOWED under copyright; no endorsement or protected-mark use
records.attribution_obligations: None under copyright; acknowledge FAA/DOT as provenance and do not imply endorsement
records.third_party_exclusions: Exclude protected FAA/DOT marks from learned content and any specifically credited or copyrighted third-party material found during actual-byte review.
